name: agentsafe-guard
description: Add MetaMynd runtime governance to a Node agent: every tool call is allowed, refused or held for a person before it runs.

interface.shortDescription: Allow, refuse or hold an agent's tool calls before they run
interface.longDescription: Adds MetaMynd governance to a Node agent. Each tool call is checked against a mandate the agent cannot edit, and a refused call never reaches the tool.
defaultPrompt: Add MetaMynd governance to this agent's tools
